characters.name: Kestrel Vane
characters.story_function: the finest reader of the books in their generation, asking whether anything can be given rather than owed

core.wound: pledged at eleven to settle a family debt, and told it was an honour
core.lie: worth is a balance you must keep positive, and love is the interest paid on it
core.want: to become indispensable enough that no one can discard them again
core.need: to be known by someone who has the power to leave and stays anyway
core.fear: owing something that cannot be repaid

surface.verbal_tic: phrases everything as terms and conditions
surface.physical_signature: ink under the nails; hands always doing a second task

capability.spike: reads financial instruments the way others read faces
capability.secondary: knows who in any room actually decides
capability.hole: cannot accept a gift without immediate repayment

bonds.leverage_over_them: the pledge that bought their schooling is still an open entry

characters.offstage_life: quietly discharging the family's remaining standing, one instalment at a time

trajectory.exit_condition: survives; makes one public, unaccounted gift

contradictions: usefulness buys visibility, and visibility is what the wound cannot survive

characters.name: Sila Corr
characters.need_that_licenses: Kestrel's method needs a mirror that shows what it costs
characters.story_function: mirrors the MC's method with a different wound; proves the method is not destiny

core.wound: was given away to settle someone else's obligation
core.lie: A clean conscience is worth more than a saved life.
core.want: to secure a position where they can never again be being replaceable
core.need: to be met on the axis of clean means vs necessary ends and survive the answer

surface.mask: reasonableness used as a battering ram
surface.verbal_tic: answers questions with questions when cornered
surface.physical_signature: unnatural stillness that makes others fidget

capability.spike: acquires dialects and registers unnervingly fast
capability.secondary: recalls exact wording of anything ever said to them
capability.hole: brilliant under pressure, useless at a dinner table

bonds.loyalty_shape: loyal to terms, not people; will honor a bad deal to the letter
bonds.to_protagonist: undefined — set on first shared scene
bonds.leverage_over_them: knowledge that they quietly teaching someone the thing they were denied

characters.offstage_life: quietly teaching someone the thing they were denied

trajectory.arc_shape: slow thaw, earned by small repeated acts
trajectory.break_point: undefined — name the scene that cracks them
trajectory.exit_condition: undefined — how they leave the novel, on or off the page

contract.entry_pretext: called in by an established character under pressure
first_appearance_conditions: The scene must need them for a reason the reader already feels.
They arrive mid-action, doing their own business, not waiting to be met.
One concrete detail from `surface` lands in the first three lines.
contract.do_not_reveal_before: the wound; it is earned, never introduced

contradictions: The mask (reasonableness used as a battering ram) cannot protect the spike (acquires dialects and registers unnervingly fast) when it is tested in public.
Their loyalty (loyal to terms, not people; will honor a bad deal to the letter) guarantees they will meet the thing they fear: being replaceable.
The lie — A clean conscience is worth more than a saved life. — will look true for most of their time on the page.
